_: Pando (painting-company row 334), its light over the aspen clone by Fish Lake, Utah, gathered with Throats' at the whole Earth: the gathering touched, the Earth comes nearer until they part, then Pando's light. Touched, its card comes up with the toy playing in it; the card touched, it grows to the glass; the Earth mark, and the toy shrinks back into its card (row 355).
